description: An engaging piece for a magazine or website — informal to semi-formal tone, aims to interest the reader.

items.prompt:
You see this notice on an international website:

We're looking for articles about a place you love visiting. Write about the place, what makes it special, and why other people should visit it.

Write your article.
Your local magazine has asked readers to write an article about a skill that changed their life. Write about the skill, how you learned it, and how it has helped you.
An online magazine is collecting articles about memorable meals. Write about a meal you will never forget and why it was so memorable.

description: A semi-formal or formal response to a specific situation — clear structure, appropriate register.

items.prompt: You recently stayed at a hotel and had a problem with your room. Write an email to the hotel manager explaining what happened and what you would like them to do about it.
A friend is planning to visit your country for the first time. Write an email giving them advice about what to bring, where to go, and what to avoid.
You have seen a job advertisement for a part-time position that interests you. Write an email applying for the job, explaining your skills and why you are suitable.

description: An opinion piece evaluating something for other readers — description plus a clear recommendation.

items.prompt: Write a review of a restaurant you have visited recently for a local website. Say what the food and service were like, and whether you would recommend it.
An online magazine has asked readers to review a book they have read recently. Write a review saying what the book was about and whether you would recommend it.
Write a review of an app or piece of software you use regularly. Say what it does, what you like and dislike about it, and whether you would recommend it.

description: A short narrative — clear sequence of events, often built around a given opening or closing line.

items.prompt:
Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must begin with this sentence:

"As soon as I opened the door, I knew something was wrong."

You have been asked to write a story for a competition. Your story must end with this sentence:

"From that day on, everything was different."

Your English teacher has asked you to write a story. Your story must include:

a lost object and an unexpected phone call.
